remarks: Imagine waking up to breathtaking sunrises over Norwalk Harbor and winding down your day with spectacular sunsets over Veteran's Park-all from the comfort of your elegantly renovated apartment!   Expansive windows invite tons of natural light, boasting breathtaking views of the Long Island Sound. This exquisite home offers a rare blend of tranquility and convenience. This true one bedroom, one bathroom gem has a thoughtfully designed kitchen and meticulously curated bathroom, featuring contemporary finishes, sleek fixtures, and modern appliances, ensuring both style and functionality.  A reserved covered parking space and storage area are included. Pets will be considered on a case-by-case basis.  If stunning views, a prime location, and a clean beautifully renovated space are what you need-don't wait! This rare opportunity won't last!
